theme: A quiet day around Mike's surgery, closing on a call to Tokyo.
greeting: Most of today has been logistics around Mike's oral surgery in Portland, Dan. The one thing still ahead is the 9 PM call with Chie and Mike on the next stage of the IMC research.

needsAttention.title: IMC research call with Chie and Mike
needsAttention.detail: The Teams call on the next stage of the IMC research is at 9 PM your time, Friday morning for Chie in Tokyo. Worth arriving with a view on her idea to widen the conversation beyond asset managers and owners.

needsAttention.title: Early start, then the boat to Vinalhaven
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow keeps Mike's recovery light but still runs long: Juliano at 9:30, clothes in the mail by 11, then the noon drive to Rockland for the ferry. The calendar's own note: bring the Forester keys.

acts.line: A haircut at 10, with Mike's oral surgery in Portland anchoring the day.
The afternoon bent around getting Mike home from Portland after the sedation.
It closes on a call to Tokyo, Chie and Mike at 9 for the IMC research.
